title: How the Payment Entry Write-off/Deductions work

posts.name: Hab
posts.cooked:
In the documentation (Payment Entry, section 3.5), and demonstrated in the animation with that documentation, when one creates a payment entry from a sales invoice and then reduces the “amount paid”, there should be a “difference amount” appear in the “writeoff” section, and a “write-off difference amount” button appears.

This does not happen for me, and I’m wondering if it is a bug, or if the way the form works has changed? This is using the latest docker image, updated a few days ago.

For me, when I reduce the paid amount, the allocated amount in the payment references table (i.e beside the invoice) also changes to match, and the difference amount stays at zero. Only after I manually then change the “allocated” field to match the reduced paid amount does the difference amount become non-zero and the button appears.

As a new user, this had me super confused for a long time until I realise what was happening. Is it a bug, or does the documentation need updating?
